definitions.formula: count distinct order_id at the requested window grain
definitions.null_policy: order_id and purchase_date are required by the curated hard gate
limitations: Counts historical Olist orders and does not represent live commerce traffic.

definitions.formula: count orders where order_status = delivered
definitions.null_policy: blank status is rejected before curation
limitations: Delivery status is the source-system status, not independent logistics proof.

definitions.formula: count orders where order_status = canceled
definitions.null_policy: blank status is rejected before curation
limitations: Cancellation status is not a refund amount or refund completion signal.

definitions.formula: count orders where order_status = unavailable
definitions.null_policy: blank status is rejected before curation
limitations: The source does not provide a normalized unavailable-reason taxonomy.

definitions.formula: count orders whose status is one of the eight documented Olist statuses
definitions.null_policy: unknown nonblank statuses remain in order_count and are excluded here
limitations: This denominator is versioned to the eight documented statuses.

definitions.formula: order_count - status_eligible_order_count
definitions.null_policy: unknown nonblank statuses are retained
limitations: A nonzero value is reportable quality evidence, not silently discarded data.

definitions.formula: delivered_order_count / status_eligible_order_count
definitions.null_policy: zero denominator returns null
limitations: Window rates are independently recomputed and cannot be added.

definitions.formula: canceled_order_count / status_eligible_order_count
definitions.null_policy: zero denominator returns null
limitations: Window rates are independently recomputed and cannot be added.

definitions.formula: count distinct customer_unique_id
definitions.null_policy: missing customer identity fails the curated hard gate
limitations: Counts Olist pseudonymous customer identities, not verified people.

definitions.formula: count customers with at least two orders inside the independently computed window
definitions.null_policy: missing customer identity fails the curated hard gate
limitations: DAY and MONTH repeat customers cannot be summed into FULL.

definitions.formula: repeat_customer_count / unique_customer_count
definitions.null_policy: zero denominator returns null
limitations: The repeat condition is recalculated inside each requested window.

definitions.formula: sum order-item price after one-row-per-order pre-aggregation
definitions.null_policy: missing item rows contribute zero at order overview grain
limitations: Currency is unspecified; discounts, refunds and exchange conversion are unavailable.

definitions.formula: sum order-item freight_value after one-row-per-order pre-aggregation
definitions.null_policy: missing item rows contribute zero at order overview grain
limitations: Currency is unspecified and freight adjustments after the source snapshot are unavailable.

definitions.formula: sum payment_value after one-row-per-order pre-aggregation
definitions.null_policy: orders without payment rows contribute zero
limitations: Payment records do not establish settlement, refunds, currency or audited revenue.

definitions.formula: order-item row count / order_count
definitions.null_policy: zero denominator returns null
limitations: Olist has no quantity column, so this is a row-count proxy rather than physical quantity.

definitions.display_name: 配送时长可计算订单数
definitions.formula: count delivered orders with usable purchase and customer-delivery timestamps
definitions.null_policy: missing or invalid lifecycle timestamps are excluded and counted separately
limitations: Timestamps use source-local semantics because the source timezone is unspecified.

definitions.formula: average elapsed seconds from purchase to customer delivery divided by 86400
definitions.null_policy: zero eligible orders returns null
limitations: Source timezone is unspecified and durations are descriptive rather than SLA evidence.

definitions.formula: approx_percentile(delivery_days, 0.50)
definitions.null_policy: zero eligible orders returns null
limitations: This is an approximate percentile and may vary slightly by engine implementation.

definitions.formula: approx_percentile(delivery_days, 0.90)
definitions.null_policy: zero eligible orders returns null
limitations: This is an approximate percentile and may vary slightly by engine implementation.

definitions.display_name: 晚于预计日期送达订单数
definitions.formula: count eligible delivered orders where delivered_customer_date > estimated_delivery_date
definitions.null_policy: missing estimate or delivery timestamp is excluded
limitations: The metric compares source timestamps and is not a contractual SLA breach determination.

definitions.formula: late_delivery_order_count / late-delivery-eligible delivered orders
definitions.null_policy: zero denominator returns null
limitations: Window rates are independently recomputed and cannot be added.

definitions.formula: count payment_fact rows
definitions.null_policy: orders without payments contribute zero
limitations: Multiple payment rows may belong to one order.

definitions.formula: count distinct order_id with at least one payment row
definitions.null_policy: orders without payment rows are excluded
limitations: A payment row does not prove settlement and grouped order counts are not additive.

definitions.formula: count distinct orders having payment_installments > 1
definitions.numerator: orders with an installment payment row
definitions.null_policy: missing payment rows are excluded
limitations: An order may have multiple payment rows and appears once per payment-type group it uses.

definitions.formula: count distinct order_id inside each payment_type group
definitions.numerator: distinct order IDs per payment type
definitions.null_policy: unknown payment types remain explicit groups
limitations: One order can use multiple payment types, so grouped order counts must not be summed.

definitions.display_name: 支付方式记录金额合计
definitions.formula: sum payment_value inside each source payment_type group
definitions.null_policy: unknown payment types remain explicit groups
limitations: Currency, settlement and refund status are unavailable.

definitions.formula: count distinct order_id at the selected dimension grain
definitions.null_policy: unknown dimensions remain explicit groups
limitations: An order can appear in multiple product, seller or seller-state groups.

definitions.formula: count order-item rows for item-derived dimensions
definitions.null_policy: null for dimensions not derived from item facts
limitations: This is a row-count proxy because Olist has no quantity column.

definitions.formula: count distinct customer_unique_id at the selected dimension grain
definitions.null_policy: missing customer identity fails the curated hard gate
limitations: A customer may appear in multiple groups and grouped counts are non-additive.

definitions.display_name: 分组商品明细金额合计
definitions.formula: sum item_value for item-derived dimensions
definitions.null_policy: null for dimensions where item allocation is semantically unavailable
limitations: Currency is unspecified; cross-dimension totals must not be combined.

definitions.display_name: 分组运费明细金额合计
definitions.formula: sum freight_value for item-derived dimensions
definitions.null_policy: null for dimensions where item allocation is semantically unavailable
limitations: Currency is unspecified; cross-dimension totals must not be combined.

definitions.display_name: 分组支付记录金额合计
definitions.formula: sum one-row-per-order payment totals at customer_state; attach whole-order payment total once per distinct order and seller_state
definitions.null_policy: null for product, category and seller dimensions
limitations: seller_state groups are deliberately non-additive because one order may touch multiple seller_state values; currency and settlement are unspecified.

definitions.formula: count distinct late-eligible order IDs after deduplicating order and state
definitions.null_policy: null for product, category and seller dimensions
exclusions: orders not eligible for late-delivery comparison
limitations: State groups can overlap and must not be summed as a global total.

definitions.formula: ranking_late_delivery_order_count / grouped late-delivery-eligible orders
definitions.null_policy: null when unavailable or denominator is zero
exclusions: orders not eligible for late-delivery comparison
limitations: Rates are independently recomputed at each dimension and window.

definitions.formula: sum valid review rows after per-order aggregation
definitions.numerator: review rows with score between 1 and 5
definitions.null_policy: invalid scores are excluded and retained in quality evidence
limitations: Multiple valid review rows may exist for one order.

definitions.formula: count orders with at least one valid review row
definitions.null_policy: orders without valid reviews are excluded
limitations: Review presence is measured against all order facts in the window.

definitions.formula: reviewed_order_count / order_count
definitions.null_policy: zero order denominator returns null
exclusions: invalid review scores from the numerator
limitations: Coverage is not a response-rate estimate outside the observed dataset.

definitions.formula: average of each order's valid-review average
definitions.null_policy: zero reviewed orders returns null
limitations: Each reviewed order receives one vote regardless of its review-row count.

definitions.formula: count reviewed orders whose per-order average score is <= 2
definitions.null_policy: orders without valid reviews are excluded
limitations: Low score uses the versioned threshold of two after per-order averaging.

definitions.formula: low_score_order_count / reviewed_order_count
definitions.null_policy: zero reviewed-order denominator returns null
limitations: Window rates are independently recomputed and cannot be added.

definitions.formula: count orders having more than one valid review row
definitions.null_policy: invalid review rows do not enter the count
limitations: This is reportable source behavior and does not imply duplicate fraud.

definitions.formula: manifest and source-report order row count
definitions.null_policy: missing evidence fails publication
limitations: This metric refers to source order rows, while all nine source counts remain in quality JSON.

definitions.formula: count order_fact rows at the pinned snapshot
definitions.null_policy: missing snapshot evidence fails publication
limitations: This count is snapshot-specific and not a mutable current-table count.

definitions.formula: sum duplicate-key findings across curated facts and dimensions
definitions.null_policy: missing evidence fails publication
limitations: A nonzero value fails publication.

definitions.formula: sum required orphan-key findings
definitions.null_policy: missing evidence fails publication
limitations: A nonzero value fails publication.

definitions.formula: sum versioned invalid and unknown value findings
definitions.null_policy: missing evidence fails publication
limitations: Some nonzero values are reportable rather than destructive hard failures.

definitions.formula: count orders failing the curated lifecycle ordering predicate
definitions.null_policy: missing optional timestamps are reported separately from contradictory timestamps
limitations: Source timezone is unspecified and optional missing timestamps are not automatically anomalies.

definitions.formula: count orders having both item-plus-freight and payment aggregates
definitions.null_policy: orders missing either side are excluded and remain visible in evidence
exclusions: orders missing item or payment aggregates
limitations: Comparison does not establish accounting correctness, refunds or settlement.

definitions.display_name: 金额精确核对一致订单数
definitions.formula: count comparable orders where payment_value = item_value + freight_value at two decimals
definitions.null_policy: orders missing either side are excluded
exclusions: orders missing item or payment aggregates
limitations: Equality is descriptive source reconciliation and not an audit opinion.

definitions.display_name: 金额核对不一致订单数
definitions.formula: amount_comparable_order_count - amount_reconciled_order_count
definitions.null_policy: orders missing either side are excluded
exclusions: orders missing item or payment aggregates
limitations: A mismatch is reportable evidence and may reflect source business rules not modeled here.

definitions.formula: amount_reconciled_order_count / amount_comparable_order_count
definitions.null_policy: zero comparable-order denominator returns null
exclusions: orders missing item or payment aggregates
limitations: This is source reconciliation coverage, not an audit or revenue-quality score.

definitions.display_name: 支付与商品加运费绝对差平均值
definitions.formula: average abs(payment_value - item_value - freight_value) over comparable orders
definitions.null_policy: zero comparable orders returns null
exclusions: orders missing item or payment aggregates
limitations: Currency is unspecified and the statistic is descriptive rather than audited.

definitions.display_name: 支付与商品加运费绝对差P50（近似）
definitions.formula: approx_percentile(abs difference, 0.50)
definitions.null_policy: zero comparable orders returns null
exclusions: orders missing item or payment aggregates
limitations: Currency is unspecified and this is an approximate percentile.

definitions.display_name: 支付与商品加运费绝对差P90（近似）
definitions.formula: approx_percentile(abs difference, 0.90)
definitions.null_policy: zero comparable orders returns null
exclusions: orders missing item or payment aggregates
limitations: Currency is unspecified and this is an approximate percentile.
